info.title: API.SH: Target
info.description: The Target API from API.SH: public Target data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The products of a Target brand page (target.com/b/...), with every brand-page filter and sort: TCIN, title, brand, price, regular price, saving, rating, reviews, images, link and promotions; plus the total, facets (to pass back as `facets`) and sort options. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/target-brand

parameters.name: brand_id
parameters.description: Brand id (the part after N- in the link) instead of url.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Target store id for prices and availability (default 3991).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products of a Target category (browse) page, 24 per page: title, brand, price, rating, images, promotions and more, with the category name, breadcrumbs, related categories, facets (pass their ids back as `facets`) and sort options. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/target-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A Target category id, the part after N- in a target.com/c/ link (5xt1a is Grocery). Required unless `url` is given.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A target.com/c/<name>/-/N-<id> category page; facets in the link are applied too.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Facet ids from `facets` (brand, price, rating, deals...), comma separated.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Target store id for prices and availability (default 3991).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every child variant of a Target product (each size, color, ...): TCIN, attribute values (e.g. Color, Size), title, DPCI, UPC, price, current and regular retail, price type, original price, saving, image, swatch, link, shipping and store availability flags, free shipping and promotions; plus the variation dimensions and the parent's price range. A product without variants answers an empty list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/target-product-variations

parameters.description: Target product id (TCIN) of the product or any of its variants, or a product link.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
